targets.title: Brain aging in major depressive disorder: results from the ENIGMA major depressive disorder working group.
targets.outcome_quote: This replication study using data from 13 cohorts around the world confirmed our previous findings that persons with major depressive disorder show advanced brain aging compared to controls by approximately +1 year.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Overall conclusion explicitly confirms the original brain-age gap using new independent cohorts. Cohort heterogeneity does not override that verdict.

reasoning: Full article title, authors and DOI verified. Independent pooled cohorts retest one earlier ENIGMA paper. Other studies are contextual comparisons rather than specifically assigned retest targets. Additional analysis of the original cohort is subordinate to the primary new-sample replication.
